verdict.rationale: Vendor docs clearly cover grounding: you train Fin on your own knowledge and policies, add content and synced websites, pull in Zendesk, Confluence and Notion as a single source of truth, and Fin Voice answers are described as grounded in your knowledge base. A knowledge-retrieval API and a content-import SDK call back this up. Nothing in the pack shows Fin displaying which article or source an answer came from, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of per-answer source citations or article attribution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of grounding accuracy.
